page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Small marginal notes in the right margin, partly obscured by red stains.

main_text.p: Phocenses ob fortissimè rem contra vastatores Gallos gestam loco suo sunt re-stituti. Demum, Augustus Cæsar rem denuò novavit. Nam Nicopoli à se conditæ in memoriam victoriæ Actiacæ, submotis Magnesiis, Meleensibus, Phthiotis, Ænianibus, ac Thessaliæ accensis, jus societatis Amphictyonicæ dedit, ut idem tradit Pausanias. Et hic idem affirmat, suo adhuc tempore (vixit autem & floruit cum Antonino Pio Rom. imp.) concilium illud incolume fuisse, & assessores tum habuisse xxx. Cætera verò, quæ de numero Pylago-rarum à singulis populis datorum ibi-dem dicit, non satis convenientia se-cum, omitto. Æschines, quod præterire non possum, in oratione illa celeberri-main Ctesiphontem & Demosthen[?]em ait, se cum duobus aliis Midiâ Anagyra-sio & Thrasicle Lesbio Pylagoram de-delebosignatum, archonte Theophrasto, cum his & cum sacerdote Diogneto ad Pylas missum ab Athenien-sibus, ut sederet in conventu Amphictyonum, &, quæ agenda, illic ageret: exponitque prolixè, quæ ibidem civitatis suæ nomine egerit, & ab ovo repetit ea, sparsim atq; obiter ab aliis de Cirrhæis & campo Cirrhæo, deque Amphissiis dicuntur, gloriaturque, se præcipuo

page.notes: Right margin partly covered by red stains and show-through; "ma" and "delebo" are read with doubt, and other faint marginal words near "Diogneto", "celeberrima" and the lower right corner are illegible. "Demosthenem" is partly obscured by a stain, so the letters are marked [?]. Hyphenated line breaks "Pylago-rarum", "ibi-dem", "se-cum", "Anagyra-sio", "Athenien-sibus", "re-stituti" and "de-signatum" are kept as printed. The word "Anagyrasio" is read from a line-end hyphen and may be a broken name. The page ends with the catchword "autore" on the next page.
